headline: Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse In Turmoil As Frontline Assaults Escalate
war_summary: Stonecradle has exploded into relentless upheaval, racking up nine strategic base transfers across Trammel Pool and The Heir's Knife alongside more than thirty-two hundred casualties over the past two hours alone. Weathered Expanse matches this tempestuous tempo, posting ten further turnovers—notably around Frostmarch and Wightwalk—while absorbing over four thousand combined dead in the same span. To the east, Stlican Shelf has shaken off its earlier quietude with three fresh transitions, while Godcrofts and Fishermans Row witness sudden coastal ruptures, marked by a sharp surge of reinforcements in Godcrofts and the loss of Dankana Post. Linn of Mercy sustains severe pressure with two recent base exchanges and heavy mutual attrition exceeding twenty-two hundred casualties. Conversely, earlier flare-ups across Farranac Coast and Viper Pit have subsided into relative stillness, with no territorial swaps noted over the past two hours. Callahan's Passage continues to endure severe attritional grinding—swallowing over twenty-six hundred men in two hours—yet its fortified perimeter holds fast without yielding ground.
